description: This file contains the PHP class `Attribute` within the `Opencart.Admin.Controller.Catalog` namespace. It implements the controller logic for managing product attributes in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, editing, creating, and saving attribute data. The class interacts with models, handles HTTP requests, manages session and URL linking, and renders views for the attribute management interface.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling product attribute management in the OpenCart admin panel. Manages listing, editing, creating, and saving product attributes.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling product attribute management in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, editing, creating, deleting, and autocompleting attributes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for listing and managing attributes in the admin panel, sets up data and loads the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with the list of attributes, primarily used for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for displaying the list of attributes, including pagination and sorting controls.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the attribute creation/edit form with pre-filled data if editing an existing attribute.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated attribute data submitted from the form. Includes permission checks and validation.
